criteria.description: Source handles interrupted staging and final registry swap without activating unregistered packs.
Windows native locking and interrupted staging validated by independent operator.
Recorded post-update check and native Windows build receipt.
Operator explicitly accepts the exact candidate.
Exact package source formats are valid and C4 model reviewed.
Original acceptance criteria and reviewed bounded next pass are preserved.
Typed metadata, collection references, taxonomy and original multi-deck fixture validate and reject unsafe content.
Feature-negotiated SDK declines missing Tavi host support.
Operator reviews UI cards, host security and proposed integration contract without declaring production support.
Install only after host approval, validate data and SHA256, preserve previous pack on failed update, and persist preferences.
Reject spoofed sessions and private paths; scope resource access to approved caller and capability.
Operator independently approves Windows storage and host integration requirements; validate C4 model.
Source modules and evidence stay visible after ZipRunner protected path filtering; no weakening of runtime/** rule.
Canonical Windows ZipRunner build passes exact 0.1.6 package with protected runtime state unchanged.

checks.description: Crash-stage and registry recovery, orphan activation failure, symlink and separate-process contention
assertions: Abandoned scratch is removed under OS-held lock
Finalized unregistered releases remain inactive
Corrupt registry and cache symlinks reject unsafe cleanup

checks.instructions: Capture the exact Windows ZipRunner build log (python 3.13.14), confirm test_recovery.py and test_core.py pass, manually restart after staging interruption in a disposable root, record screenshot/log and confirm unchanged selected card back.

Launch python tools/asset.py --root .tavi-assets preview --open, install cards, choose blue, restart, update and uninstall; capture actual UI evidence.
Reconcile original Workboard tasks, approve or reject the exact ZIP separately. Do not auto-push, tag or publish.
